title: Single Cell Isolation from Human Skeletal Muscle
author: Hongbo Zhang
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.q5wdy7e
materials: Single cell isolation from human skeletal muscle

steps.title: Prepare Collagenase II Stock Solution
steps.instruction: Prepare a 1000 U/ml Collagenase II solution in 1X PBS (approx. 4.35 mg/ml for 230U/mg powder).

substeps.instruction: Sterilize with a 0.22 μm filter.
Store as 1-ml aliquots at −20°C.
Thaw on ice before use.

steps.title: Prepare Dispase Stock Solution
steps.instruction: Prepare an 11 U/ml Dispase solution in 1X PBS (approx. 6.15 mg/ml for 1.79U/mg powder).

substeps.instruction: Sterilize with a 0.22 μm filter.
Store as 1-ml aliquots at −20°C.
Thaw and centrifuge at >10,000 rpm for 1 min before use, avoiding the pellet during digestion.

steps.title: Prepare Fresh Collagenase II WM Solution
steps.instruction: Prepare 15 ml of 750 U/ml Collagenase II solution in WM for each human sample by dissolving powder in PBS (approx. 3.26 mg/ml or 48.9 mg for 15 ml).

substeps.instruction: Sterilize with a 0.22 μm filter if necessary.
Keep on ice until needed.

steps.title: Prepare Percoll Solution
steps.instruction: Mix Percoll solution 9:1 with 10x PBS (e.g., 4.5 ml Percoll + 0.5 ml 10X PBS).

steps.title: Prepare Reagents and Samples
steps.instruction: Prepare 15 ml of Muscle dissociation media for each human sample and move Collagenase and Dispase stock solutions from -20°C to ice.

steps.title: Collect and Clean Muscle Tissue
steps.instruction: Collect ±2g of human intercostal muscle in a 35mm tissue culture dish with ±3ml PBS.

substeps.instruction: Remove fat from muscle using scissors.
Wash the muscle with 1X PBS twice.

steps.title: Mechanically Process Muscle
steps.instruction: Mince the muscle tissue to break down the structure.

substeps.instruction: Mechanically chop muscle into 1mm pieces with a razor, mixing red and white muscles.
Weight and divide muscle: typically 0.3g for nuclei isolation and ±2g for single cell isolation.
Continue to mince for 2 min until no large muscle pieces remain.

steps.title: Initial Enzymatic Digestion
steps.instruction: Digest the tissue in Muscle dissociation medium for 90 min in a 37°C water bath, shaking every 15 min.

steps.title: Secondary Enzymatic Digestion
steps.instruction: Perform a second digestion step to further dissociate cells.

substeps.instruction: Remove the supernatant and suspend cells in 7.18 ml PBS.
Add 1 ml collagenase and 1.82 ml dispase stock solution.
Mix tissue well by pipetting up and down using a 10 ml serological pipette.
Digest for 30 min in a 37°C water bath, shaking every 15 min.

steps.title: Stop Digestion and Filter Cells
steps.instruction: Halt the enzymatic process and remove debris.

substeps.instruction: Stop digestion by adding 10 ml of 2% FBS in PBS.
Filter cells successively through 100 μm and 40 μm strainers.

steps.title: Wash and Prepare for Percoll Gradient
steps.instruction: Concentrate and resuspend cells for density gradient centrifugation.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 650g for 3 min to pellet cells.
Wash cells once with 2% FBS in PBS.
Resuspend cells in 10 ml of 2% FBS.
Add 2.86 ml of Percoll solution to create a 20% Percoll-cell solution.
Transfer solution to a specific high-speed (red cap) 50 ml centrifuge tube and prepare a balance tube.
Centrifuge at 15,000g for 20 min at 4°C, setting the brake to 5 (instead of the normal 9).

steps.title: Collect and Wash Intact Cells
steps.instruction: Recover the isolated cells and remove Percoll.

substeps.instruction: Remove the supernatant and collect the cell layer, or collect cells directly from the solution using a 1 ml pipette.
Wash the cells with 10 volumes of 2% FBS in PBS.

steps.title: Quantify Cell Yield
steps.instruction: Stain intact cells with trypan blue and quantify using a hemocytometer.
